svg.title: Vocello by the numbers
svg.desc: 1.7 billion parameters in each mode's model; 8-bit attention layers on a 4-bit model; about 36,000 upstream lines removed from the owned runtime; 24 kHz mono audio from a native decoder; Swift 6 strict concurrency, with actors owning the engine; no Python at runtime.
